about: Rev3.0 glass-front concept GF-1.0, flat list (same values as the master file)

parameters.name: glass_t
parameters.note: glass thickness, DRIVING; design valid for 1.1 / 2.0 / 3.0 / 4.0 (sec. 3 table)

parameters.name: t_opt
parameters.note: optical bond glass -> CTP lens (LOCA / silicone gel, hard stops 0.30 +-0.03; R1 sec.3.3)

parameters.name: t_bond
parameters.note: glass -> land bond line, elastic gap-filling bead, nominal (set by the flush jig)

parameters.name: t_sheet
parameters.note: oven front sheet, steel (0.8-1.5); lip height above the seat ring = t_sheet

parameters.name: t_gap
parameters.note: flange front -> sheet back between hard stops (seat ring + corner pads); VHB 1.1 or foam 1.5 lives here

parameters.name: g_bs
parameters.note: panel back -> Formex air gap, nominal (back-stop)

parameters.name: print_inset
parameters.note: print window = AA inset by this per side; ALTERNATIVE AA + 0.25 (R1 sec.3.3 step 7) = -0.25

parameters.name: border
parameters.note: window edge -> glass edge, top / left / right (A1)

parameters.name: glass_y1
parameters.note: glass bottom edge, abs y (A1; chin)

parameters.name: R_glass
parameters.note: glass corner radius (R2: >= 3)

parameters.name: g2
parameters.note: gap glass edge -> lip inner face at 20 C

parameters.name: lip_w
parameters.note: lip width (root)

parameters.name: g1
parameters.note: gap lip outer face -> sheet cut-out edge at 20 C

parameters.name: seat_ring_w
parameters.note: sheet-seat ring width outside the lip (s 1.4 .. 2.9)

parameters.name: pocket_clr
parameters.note: panel outline -> clearance pocket wall, per side

parameters.name: bead_w
parameters.note: glass->frame bead width after squeeze (A1)

parameters.name: bead_edge
parameters.note: bead outer edge inside the glass edge (A1: >= 0.9)

parameters.name: bead_pocket_min
parameters.note: min distance bead inner edge -> pocket face (A1)

parameters.name: fast_off
parameters.note: fastener centre outside the glass edge, in x and y (corners) / in the normal direction (mid-sides)

parameters.name: flange_beyond_glass
parameters.note: flange outline = glass + this (pad/tube R9 + 1 mm beyond the fastener)

parameters.name: flange_R
parameters.note: flange outer corner radius (centre = corner fastener)

parameters.name: flange_t
parameters.note: flange thickness = wall (v2)

parameters.name: slot_w
parameters.note: fastener stadium slot width (A4 asked 5.0; 5.4 needed for a dia-4.8 rivet, sec. 11)

parameters.name: slot_l
parameters.note: fastener stadium slot length, long axis towards the glass centre (A4 asked 6.5)

parameters.name: pad_d
parameters.note: corner pad dia (front, top at Z_SHEET_BACK) and fastener tube top dia (back)

parameters.name: tube_h
parameters.note: fastener tube height above the flange back (washer / rivet seat)

parameters.name: pip_d
parameters.note: stand-off pip dia at the base (A2), 1 deg draft

parameters.name: pip_h
parameters.note: stand-off pip height above the land (A2), +-0.05

parameters.name: tape_w
parameters.note: VHB strip width (standard 12 mm roll, 3M 5952 class, 1.1 thick) (A3)

parameters.name: tape_margin
parameters.note: min flat flange face beyond each tape edge (A3)

parameters.name: trough_R
parameters.note: tail-pocket bottom inner corner radius (keeps 1.5 to the TFT loop corner)

parameters.name: Z_TROUGH_TOP
parameters.note: tail-pocket walls / bottom beam top, outside the board only [= 4.05 (v2)] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_PCB
parameters.note: PCB back = boss / support-rib / pocket-wall tops [= 0 (v2)] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_SHELF_BACK
parameters.note: shelf back [= -2.10 (v2)] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_SEAT
parameters.note: shelf front = Formex back (Formex PSA-bonded) [= -4.60 (v2)] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_FORMEX_FRONT
parameters.note: Formex front (= v2 panel back) [= Z_SEAT - 0.40] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_PANEL_BACK
parameters.note: panel back, nominal (floats with the tolerances, sec. 4c) [= Z_FORMEX_FRONT - g_bs] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_CTP_FRONT
parameters.note: CTP cover-lens front (panel_t 5.32) [= Z_PANEL_BACK - panel_t] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_GLASS_BACK
parameters.note: glass printed face [= Z_CTP_FRONT - t_opt] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_GLASS_FRONT
parameters.note: FLUSH PLANE = lip top = sheet front [= Z_GLASS_BACK - glass_t] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_SHEET_BACK
parameters.note: sheet back = seat-ring top = corner-pad tops = parting plane [= Z_GLASS_FRONT + t_sheet] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_FLANGE_FRONT
parameters.note: flange front face (tape / gasket on it) [= Z_SHEET_BACK + t_gap] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_FLANGE_BACK
parameters.note: flange back [= Z_FLANGE_FRONT + flange_t; = Z_STEPWALL_BACK if within 0.5 of Z_LANDPLATE_BACK (level snap)] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_LAND
parameters.note: glass land = recess floor (bead, pips) [= Z_GLASS_BACK + t_bond] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_PIP_TOP
parameters.note: stand-off pip tops [= Z_LAND - pip_h] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_LANDPLATE_BACK
parameters.note: land-plate back (corner-cell floors, PCB-boss bases) [= Z_LAND + wall] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_STEPWALL_BACK
parameters.note: back of the step wall [= max(Z_FLANGE_BACK, Z_LANDPLATE_BACK); snap both to it if they differ < 0.5] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_TUBE_TOP
parameters.note: fastener tube top = washer / rivet seat [= Z_FLANGE_BACK + tube_h] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_TAIL_TFT_EXIT
parameters.note: TFT tail centre at the panel edge (panel model, estimated) [= Z_PANEL_BACK - 2.6] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_TAIL_CTP_EXIT
parameters.note: CTP tail centre at the panel edge (estimated) [= Z_PANEL_BACK - 3.9] (glass_t 3.0)

parameters.name: Z_LOOP_FRONT
parameters.note: front-most point of the tail loops [= Z_TAIL_CTP_EXIT - 0.15] (glass_t 3.0)
